change: Name the coding agent you want and Omi uses it — say "use codex" and the task runs on Codex. If that agent isn't connected Omi shows you how to install it instead of quietly running a different one, and if the chosen agent can't do the job or fails to start, the task moves to the next agent that can and Omi tells you which one. If you rule out every agent that could do it, Omi says so instead of starting the task.
